dogecoin.text: @Jathin_Rishi Dogecoin may have started as a joke, but it’s now a serious player in crypto, thanks to its strong community, low fees, and fast transactions, perfect for small payments and tipping.

@Sumaika360 Dogecoin, launched in 2013, is a fun, low-cost cryptocurrency with unlimited supply, featuring the Shiba Inu dog Kabosu as its logo. It’s built on Litecoin’s tech and uses the Scrypt algorithm.
